instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot. Outdoors against a two-tone yellow and grey textured wall, a couple dances tango. The woman in the black halter dress (R2) is on the left, stepping back. The man in the grey suit (R1) is on the right, stepping forward. They hold hands and maintain a classic dance posture. Bright, direct sunlight casts sharp shadows of the dancers onto the wall.
elements: R1 is stepping forward in the tango while R2 is stepping back
R2 is the partner stepping back while R1 advances
R1 and R2 have asymmetric dance movement roles, with R1 advancing and R2 retreating
R1 and R2 hold hands in a classic tango dance posture
R1 and R2 are dancing as a couple outdoors
The dancers are against a two-tone yellow and grey textured wall in bright sunlight
